references.text: Describes the original judgment of 40 years of wandering in the wilderness as punishment for Israel's rebellion
The Lord's declaration that the entire generation that grumbled against Him would die in the wilderness
Confirmation that the whole first generation died in the wilderness, except for Caleb and Joshua
Moses recounts how the Lord became angry and swore that the evil generation would not see the Promised Land
Refers to the 38 years it took until the entire warrior generation had died out
The Lord's anger toward the generation in the wilderness who wandered in their hearts
Confirms that Israel wandered in the wilderness for 40 years until the whole disobedient generation had died
Stephen refers to the 40 years in the wilderness in his speech
The author of Hebrews reminds us that God was angry with those who sinned, and their bodies fell in the wilderness
An example of how the Lord's anger was kindled against Israel because of their complaints
Mentions that the Israelites ate manna for 40 years until they reached the Promised Land
